title: the handset boots at 1970 and stays there, so every TLS handshake fails and the iroh transport cannot come up at all — the boot screen now stays calm through it (plan 0035) but the device is unusable until the clock arrives. Root-caused: /etc/resolv.conf is 0600 root:root and chronyd runs as user `chrony`, so its pool never resolves. Fix is the rootfs's; when it lands, cold-boot the handset and confirm it reaches the contact list with no hand-set clock
